PBJ All Grown Up
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Wednesday, February 10, 2016 - 2:53pm

Ingredients




3/4 cup greek yogurt
1 tbsp. peanut butter (all natural)
1 tbsp. strawberry jam (naturally sweetened)
2 tbsp. Oatbox® granola

Preparation

1 Warm the peanut butter slightly 2 Place the yogurt in a "to go" container 3 Stir in the peanut butter 4 Place the jam on top 5 Add the granola 6 Seal the lid...and you are ready to go.

About

The classic childhood flavours with a new twist.  PBJ All Grown Up is the perfect yogurt and granola “to go” breakfast as you rush out the door.  Nutrition is possible even when you are in a hurry.
